summary: Accrued interest uses a 365.25-day year; legacy LOAN231 3000-CALC-INTEREST divides by 365 (ACT/365).
legacy_behavior: COMPUTE WS-INTEREST ROUNDED = PRINCIPAL * RATE * DAYS / 365
next_behavior: DAYS_IN_YEAR = 365.25 → interest lower by DAYS*RATE*PRINCIPAL*(1/365 - 1/365.25), diverging after rounding
